EMPIRICALLY CONFIRMED s080 — all four RFC table readers (standard RFC_READ_TABLE, BBP_RFC_READ_TABLE, /SAPDS/RFC_READ_TABLE2, custom Z_RFC_READ_TABLE) return FM_OUTPUT/ONAME/OTEXT and SILENTLY OMIT ODESC (meta doesn't even list it; ODESC-alone -> TABLE_WITHOUT_DATA). This is a field-type limit of RFC, NOT an SSO/auth issue and NOT a tooling regression — ODESC is simply the first STRG column we've needed; no prior extracted column was STRING. We do NOT use ADT against production to read data. Excel is NOT a source.
